issues.detail: The Greek 'ο απεστερημενος' (the one who has been deprived/robbed) refers to the 'μισθος' (wages). The Vietnamese translation 'bị các ngươi cướp mất' (being stolen by you) adds a specific agent ('các ngươi' - you) that is not present in the Greek text. The Greek simply states the wages are 'deprived/robbed'.
